experiences.name: Rome, Georgia Historic Downtown Art Walk
experiences.description: Explore the vibrant murals, local galleries, and public art installations scattered throughout downtown Rome, GA. Visit the Chieftains Museum and local studios showcasing regional artists, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of Northwest Georgia.

experiences.name: Farm-to-Table Dining at Local Rome Restaurants
experiences.description: Indulge in the Southern food scene along Broad Street, sampling classic Georgia cuisine including fried chicken, biscuits, and locally sourced produce at beloved local eateries and diners that define Rome's culinary identity.

experiences.name: Chieftains Museum & Major Ridge Home Tour
experiences.description: Visit this National Historic Landmark just minutes from Chateau Drive, exploring Cherokee Nation history through artifacts, art, and guided tours of the 1794 log cabin home of Major Ridge, blending cultural history with artistic storytelling.

experiences.name: Coosa Valley Farmers Market & Food Experience
experiences.description: Browse the weekly Coosa Valley Farmers Market featuring local artisan foods, handmade crafts, fresh produce, and homemade preserves. Sample Georgia-made cheeses, honey, and baked goods while meeting local food artisans and craftspeople.

experiences.name: Berry College Campus Art & Nature Exploration
experiences.description: Explore the stunning campus of Berry College, one of the world's largest college campuses, featuring beautiful Gothic architecture, an on-site art gallery, scenic trails, and wildlife. A perfect blend of artistic architecture and natural beauty just outside Rome.
experiences.location: Berry College, Mount Berry, near Rome, Georgia
